subject: Profile v2 replanned for one state; three questions
body: Profile v2 now follows D-coord-011/012 (proposed as D-contracts-005, D-contracts-006). 1) Stage demo: pre-fill contrast and drivers from a rehearsal, marked prefilled:true? Plan: yes. 2) Allow smell and taste steps in the MVP schema (no submodality keys, free text only)? Plan: yes. 3) Profiles and rep logs stay browser-only, with a JSON export? Plan: yes. Please accept or reject D-contracts-005/006 once the lanes have replied.
